E1.text:
Subject: Quote for built-in wardrobe

Hi there,

I'm after a quote for a built-in wardrobe in the main bedroom at my place in Pascoe Vale. The wall is 2.4m wide and the ceiling is 2.7m, so floor to ceiling would be great. Just the one robe. Laminate sliding doors in Polar White to match the rest of the house. We'd need it installed.

Hoping to have it done before Christmas.

Thanks,
Daniel Russo
0491 570 156
E1.title: Complete wardrobe request

E3.text:
Subject: Kitchen reno – where do we even start?

Hello,

We bought our place in Essendon last year and have finally decided to tackle the kitchen. It's the original 1970s one and honestly it's falling apart – two of the drawers don't close and the benchtop has a burn mark from the previous owners. My partner and I have been going back and forth on styles for months. We saw a display at a home show and loved the handleless look.

The room is about 4.2 by 3 metres. We're thinking two-pac doors, and the colour is still undecided between white and a soft grey. We'd want you to install it as we're not handy at all!

We're hoping to start in February if possible. Our kids are back at school then which makes it easier.

Kind regards,
Mei Lin Tan
meilin.tan@example.com
